answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 6841 Country: Pakistan Title: I had a child of 1 week. can i go to hajj with my wife, keeping in view that she is feeding baby Question: I had a child of 1 week. can i go to hajj with my wife, keeping in view that she is feeding baby Answer ID: 6841 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 940/860=L/1429) In the abovementioned case, there is no wrong in going to hajj with the wife. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
